guides.name: Adventure Consultants
guides.description: Founded by Guy Cotter, Adventure Consultants is a world-renowned expedition company with decades of experience on Everest and other 8000m peaks. They emphasize safety, acclimatization, and summit success through meticulous planning.

guides.name: Alpine Ascents International
guides.description: Based in Seattle, Alpine Ascents has guided climbers on Everest since the 1990s. Known for their experienced Western guides and strong Sherpa teams, they offer comprehensive expedition support.

guides.name: International Mountain Guides
guides.description: IMG is one of the most experienced Everest outfitters in the world, having led expeditions to the peak since 1991. They are known for their robust logistics and experienced leadership team.

guides.name: Alpenglow Expeditions
guides.description: Led by Adrian Ballinger, Alpenglow Expeditions is known for their rapid ascent protocol and innovative approach to high-altitude climbing. They focus on smaller team sizes and personalized guiding.

guides.name: Madison Mountaineering
guides.description: Founded by Garrett Madison, this company specializes in the world's most challenging peaks. They have a strong track record on K2 with experienced high-altitude guides and comprehensive expedition support.

guides.name: Alpine Ascents International
guides.description: Alpine Ascents brings their decades of high-altitude experience to K2 expeditions. Their teams are supported by seasoned Western guides and strong high-altitude porter teams.

guides.name: Adventure Consultants
guides.description: Adventure Consultants offers guided K2 expeditions with their hallmark emphasis on safety and thorough acclimatization. Their experienced leadership has guided clients on the world's most demanding mountains.

guides.name: Alaska Mountaineering School
guides.description: Based in Talkeetna, Alaska Mountaineering School has been guiding on Denali for decades. They are deeply rooted in the local climbing community and provide expert instruction alongside guiding services.

guides.name: Alpine Ascents International
guides.description: Alpine Ascents offers well-organized Denali expeditions with experienced guides and a strong emphasis on client preparedness and acclimatization on North America's highest peak.

guides.name: Mountain Trip
guides.description: Mountain Trip has been guiding Denali expeditions since 1973, making them one of the longest-operating guide services on the peak. They are known for their low guide-to-client ratios and thorough expedition planning.

guides.name: NOLS
guides.description: NOLS offers Denali mountaineering courses that combine expedition climbing with wilderness education. Their programs focus on building leadership, teamwork, and technical mountaineering skills.

guides.name: Rainier Mountaineering Inc
guides.description: RMI is the oldest and most well-known guide service on Mount Rainier, operating since 1969. They offer a range of programs from introductory mountaineering seminars to summit climbs on multiple routes.

guides.name: Alpine Ascents International
guides.description: Alpine Ascents offers Mount Rainier climbs that serve as both standalone adventures and training for higher peaks. Their programs include comprehensive glacier travel and crevasse rescue instruction.

guides.name: International Mountain Guides
guides.description: IMG has been guiding on Mount Rainier for decades, offering programs on various routes including the Disappointment Cleaver, Emmons Glacier, and Kautz Glacier. They are highly regarded for their guide training program.

guides.name: Compagnie des Guides de Chamonix
guides.description: Founded in 1821, the Compagnie des Guides de Chamonix is the oldest guide company in the world. Their certified mountain guides offer unparalleled expertise on Mont Blanc and the surrounding Alps.

guides.name: Mountain Tracks
guides.description: Mountain Tracks specializes in guided Alpine climbing and offers well-structured Mont Blanc ascent programs. They provide thorough preparation climbs and acclimatization schedules for summit success.

guides.name: Alpenglow Expeditions
guides.description: Alpenglow offers Mont Blanc expeditions with their signature emphasis on personalized guiding and small group sizes. Their programs include preparatory climbs in the Chamonix valley.

guides.name: Ultimate Kilimanjaro
guides.description: Ultimate Kilimanjaro is a leading operator focused exclusively on Kilimanjaro climbs. They offer all major routes and maintain high summit success rates through careful acclimatization protocols.

guides.name: Thomson Safaris
guides.description: Thomson Safaris combines Kilimanjaro climbs with East African safari experiences. Their Kilimanjaro programs emphasize responsible tourism and strong support teams for climbers.

guides.name: Climbing Kilimanjaro
guides.description: Climbing Kilimanjaro is a dedicated operator offering guided treks on all major Kilimanjaro routes. They provide experienced local guides and comprehensive logistical support for climbers of all experience levels.

guides.name: Inka Expediciones
guides.description: Inka Expediciones is a top Argentine outfitter specializing in Aconcagua expeditions. Based in Mendoza, they offer deep local expertise and strong logistical support on both the Normal Route and Polish Glacier.

guides.name: Acomara
guides.description: Acomara is a Mendoza-based operator with extensive experience guiding Aconcagua expeditions. They offer programs on multiple routes with strong local guide teams and well-provisioned camps.

guides.name: Alpine Ascents International
guides.description: Alpine Ascents brings their international expedition expertise to Aconcagua, offering well-structured programs with thorough acclimatization schedules and experienced Western guide teams.

guides.name: Elbrus Guides
guides.description: Elbrus Guides specializes exclusively in Mount Elbrus expeditions, offering both the south and north routes. Their local team provides deep knowledge of weather patterns and route conditions on Europe's highest peak.

guides.name: Mountain Tracks
guides.description: Mountain Tracks offers guided Elbrus expeditions with comprehensive acclimatization programs in the Caucasus. Their itineraries include preparatory hikes and well-organized summit attempts.

guides.name: Alpenglow Expeditions
guides.description: Alpenglow offers Elbrus climbs as part of their global expedition portfolio. Their programs feature small groups, experienced guides, and a focus on acclimatization and summit success.

guides.name: Zermatters
guides.description: Zermatters is Zermatt's premier mountaineering company, offering guided Matterhorn ascents via the Hornli Ridge and other routes. Their certified Swiss mountain guides bring unrivaled local expertise.

guides.name: Compagnie des Guides de Chamonix
guides.description: The Compagnie des Guides de Chamonix offers Matterhorn ascents via the Italian Ridge from Cervinia. Their UIAGM-certified guides bring centuries of collective Alpine experience.

guides.name: Alpine Ascents International
guides.description: Alpine Ascents guides Cho Oyu expeditions with experienced high-altitude leaders. Cho Oyu is often recommended as an ideal first 8000m peak, and their program emphasizes thorough acclimatization.

guides.name: Madison Mountaineering
guides.description: Madison Mountaineering offers Cho Oyu expeditions led by experienced high-altitude guides. Their programs provide a solid stepping stone for climbers aspiring to Everest or other 8000m peaks.

guides.name: Alpenglow Expeditions
guides.description: Alpenglow brings their rapid ascent approach to Cho Oyu, offering a streamlined expedition with smaller teams. Their innovative protocol reduces time at altitude while maintaining safety.

guides.name: Alpenglow Expeditions
guides.description: Alpenglow has established Manaslu as a key expedition in their 8000m portfolio. Their rapid ascent protocol and small team approach have achieved strong results on this increasingly popular peak.

guides.name: Adventure Consultants
guides.description: Adventure Consultants offers guided Manaslu expeditions with their hallmark focus on safety and client support. Their experienced team manages the technical challenges of the peak's varied terrain.

guides.name: Furtenbach Adventures
guides.description: Furtenbach Adventures is an Austrian operator known for premium high-altitude expeditions. Their Manaslu program features supplemental oxygen, strong Sherpa support, and meticulous safety protocols.

guides.name: Alpine Ascents International
guides.description: Alpine Ascents offers guided Ama Dablam expeditions, one of the most visually stunning climbs in the Himalaya. Their program includes acclimatization trekking and expert technical guidance on the Southwest Ridge.

guides.name: International Mountain Guides
guides.description: IMG guides Ama Dablam with their deep experience in the Khumbu region. Their expeditions are well-supported with fixed ropes, established camps, and experienced Sherpa teams.

guides.name: Adventure Consultants
guides.description: Adventure Consultants runs Ama Dablam expeditions with a strong focus on the technical aspects of the climb. Their program is popular with climbers looking to develop high-altitude technical skills.

guides.name: Adventure Consultants
guides.description: Adventure Consultants offers Island Peak as an accessible Himalayan climbing experience, often combined with Everest Base Camp trekking. The program provides excellent preparation for higher Himalayan objectives.

guides.name: Alpenglow Expeditions
guides.description: Alpenglow offers Island Peak expeditions as an ideal introduction to Himalayan mountaineering. Their programs feature experienced guides and well-planned acclimatization through the Khumbu valley.

guides.name: Antarctic Logistics & Expeditions
guides.description: ALE is the primary logistics provider for climbing expeditions in Antarctica, including Mount Vinson. They operate the only private air link to the Antarctic interior and provide full expedition support.

guides.name: Adventure Consultants
guides.description: Adventure Consultants offers guided Mount Vinson expeditions in partnership with Antarctic logistics providers. Their program includes experienced polar guides and comprehensive cold-weather expedition support.

guides.name: Sierra Nevada Expeditions
guides.description: Sierra Nevada Expeditions is an Ecuadorian operator specializing in guided climbs of Cotopaxi and other Ecuadorian volcanoes. They offer personalized programs with certified local guides who know the mountain intimately.

guides.name: Andean Face
guides.description: Andean Face is a Quito-based adventure company offering Cotopaxi climbs and multi-volcano programs in Ecuador. They provide acclimatization hikes and glacier climbing instruction as part of their packages.

guides.name: Mountain Rock Kenya
guides.description: Mountain Rock Kenya is one of the most experienced operators on Mount Kenya, offering treks and technical climbs on all major routes. They are a locally owned company with certified Kenyan guides.

guides.name: Savage Wilderness
guides.description: Savage Wilderness is a Kenyan adventure company offering guided Mount Kenya climbs along with other outdoor activities. They are known for their community involvement and experienced local guides.

guides.name: Madison Mountaineering
guides.description: Madison Mountaineering offers Lhotse expeditions often combined with Everest logistics, as the two peaks share a base camp and much of the route. Their experienced guides manage the technical Lhotse Face and summit push.

guides.name: Furtenbach Adventures
guides.description: Furtenbach Adventures offers premium Lhotse expeditions with comprehensive oxygen systems and strong Sherpa support. Their safety-first approach has made them a leader in guided 8000m climbing.

guides.name: Adventure Consultants
guides.description: Adventure Consultants guides Makalu expeditions for experienced mountaineers seeking one of the most challenging 8000m peaks. Their program features thorough acclimatization and expert route management.

guides.name: Alpenglow Expeditions
guides.description: Alpenglow offers Makalu as part of their portfolio of 8000m expeditions. Their small team approach and experienced leadership provide strong support on this remote and demanding peak.
